Introduction to Spring-Loaded Pogo Pins & Connectors

Overview

Description:

Spring-Loaded Pin with a Standard Tail
Plunger Type: Round
Mounting Feature:
Through-Hole Solder Mount
Mounting Hole:  .044" (1,118mm)
Tail Type: Soldertail
 .040" (1,016mm)

Product Family:

Discrete Spring Loaded Pins

Tech Specs

Mechanical life (Durability):
100,000 to 1,000,000 Cycles @ Mid-Stroke
Maximum Current:
Inner Spring Dependent, see Spring Data Below
Maximum Derated Current: Inner Spring Dependent, see Spring Data Below
Operating Temperature Range:
-55/+125° C
Vibration:
No Elect. Discontinuity > 1μs @ 10-2000HZ, 20 G
Shock:
No Elect. Discontinuity > 1μs @ 50g
